The altar is part of a larger altarpiece structure with gold leaf detailing, columns, statues in niches, and religious paintings. The altar table itself is covered with a white cloth and adorned with flowers and candles. The surrounding architecture includes marble pillars, arches, and decorative moldings.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific architectural and religious classification of the structure as an altar within a church context.
To verify the structural integrity of the complex, multi-layered baroque architecture and ensure no spatial melting between columns, statues, and background.
To check for boundary bleeding or fusion in the intricate gold leaf details, statues, and floral arrangements which are common failure points in AI generation.
To assess overall texture consistency, lighting coherence, and detect any subtle generative artifacts in the high-frequency details.

focus_areas: Structural coherence of the complex baroque altarpiece
Boundary sharpness of intricate gold carvings and statues
Consistency of perspective in the architectural arches and columns
Texture realism of marble, wood, and fabric materials
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the intricate details of the baroque altarpiece. AI generators often struggle with the logical connectivity of complex ornamental structures, leading to 'melting' gold leaf or nonsensical statue anatomy. Verify that the perspective lines of the architecture converge correctly and that the lighting on the gold surfaces is physically plausible. Check for any 'ghosting' or double edges around the high-contrast gold elements against the darker background.
